answer: Bind eligibility to reproducible build maintenance. Each identity adopts three open-source packages for 14 epochs, locks 28 POA, and publishes a signed build from a randomly chosen kernel and toolchain. A glacier beacon changes one dependency daily; six of nine auditors rebuild the artifact and compare hashes. Trust rises one terrace after ten matching builds, while duplicate artifacts earn one share. N aliases need 3N maintained packages and lock 28N POA; two mismatches burn the bond.
